gacha.intro: Your own characters, drawable on this server only. They add to the global catalogue without touching it.
gacha.injoignable: The characters could not be read (bot API unreachable). Try again later.

editeur.universAide: Cards are not drawn: they rarely drop in place of an ordinary draw, and sit apart in the collection. Video games are no longer handed out — their catalogue was too thin for a draw not to loop over it.
editeur.rareteAide: Rarity is enough: rank and value follow from it, on the same scale as the imported catalogue. Letting them be typed in would allow a custom character to show up more often than the stars.
editeur.imageInvalide: ❌ The image must be a URL starting with http:// or https://.

liste.aucun: No custom character. The ones you create here add to the global catalogue for this server only — they will not appear anywhere else.
